knowledge.q: Is there an infinite money cheat code?
knowledge.text: No. No codes have been announced for GTA VI, so there’s no money cheat either. In GTA V, no code gave you money, according to player guides; in San Andreas, HESOYAM gave $250,000 along with health and armor. To plan your purchases, the calculator works from your own numbers.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Cheat codes” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.text: In GTA V, yes, for a while: Rockstar specifies that you can save with a code active, but that achievements are disabled; reloading a save or restarting the console cancels all codes. For GTA VI, nothing has been published: no codes, and no rule on trophies and achievements.

knowledge.q: How do you enter a cheat code with the phone?
knowledge.text: In GTA V, you opened the in-game phone and dialed a number starting with 1-999: the digits after it spell out the code’s name, like 1-999-866-587 for TOOLUP, the weapons. On PC, the console opens with the ² key on a French keyboard, or ~. For GTA VI, how any codes would be entered isn’t known.
